deer.note: A standing deer. Its coat leans up toward the camera, as a back and flank seen from above do; the outline rounds the silhouette, and the legs below the belly are upright posts.

rat.note: A rat seen from above: a low body leaning up toward the camera, rounded at its outline and dark flank, with a tail and feet lying flat on the ground.

snake.note: A snake lying in coils on the ground: a tube whose top faces up, rounded down its dark outline and shaded underside.

wolf.note: A standing wolf. Its coat leans up toward the camera, as a back and flank seen from above do; the outline rounds the silhouette, and in profile the legs below the belly are upright posts.

bat.note: A bat in flight with its wings spread level: a rounded three-pixel body down the middle, and each wing a membrane drooping from the shoulder to its tip, so it faces up and out to its own side.

cave-troll.note: A hunched, round-bodied troll. Its hide leans up toward the camera, as a back seen from above does; the outline and its dark maw are rounded from the silhouette.

rabbit.note: A crouched rabbit: a small round body whose fur leans up toward the camera, rounded at its outline.

bog-imp.note: A lanky, crouching imp. Its hide leans up toward the camera, as a back and shoulders seen from above do; the outline rounds the silhouette and its thin limbs.

cyclops.note: A huge muscled cyclops. Its skin leans up toward the camera, as shoulders and a back seen from above do, and the outline rounds the silhouette; the grey muscle lines stay with the skin, since rounding them would light them as edges.
